headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.traceCutoff_ofFn
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.traceCutoff (List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c) = Math115.RetainedChainSquare.squareCutoff

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.traceInputBranch_reference_iff
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.traceInputBranch (List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c) =
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference ↔
    2 ≤ m ∧
      2 ≤ n ∧
        2 ≤
            Fintype.card
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c Math115.RetainedChainSquare.squareCutoff)) ∧
          0 <
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices
                  (Math115.RetainedChainSquare.squareCutoff, List.ofFn r)).length ∧
            0 <
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices
                  (Math115.RetainedChainSquare.squareCutoff, List.ofFn c)).length

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.traceInputBranch_noSmall_iff
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.traceInputBranch (List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c) =
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.noSmall ↔
    2 ≤ m ∧
      2 ≤ n ∧
        Fintype.card
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c Math115.RetainedChainSquare.squareCutoff)) =
          0

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.deterministicBranch_pointLaw_uniform
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.traceInputBranch (List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c) =
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.deterministic →
    ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.pointLaw X = OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
